commercialOperationalBoundarySections.heading: ## See where personal and business access still meet
commercialOperationalBoundarySections.text:
## See where personal and business access still meet

A personal identity may control business access while a work service exposes private information. Looking at either account alone can miss the relationship between them.

Dr. Tabansky examines the relevant connections across your devices, identities and services, including what they permit and what depends on them. The work gives you a basis for separating access deliberately while accounting for services you still need. It stays within your lawful authority and agreed scope.

A connection does not establish that a partner, competitor or adviser has used access improperly.

commercialOperationalBoundarySections.heading: ## Understand what a change will affect before you approve it
commercialOperationalBoundarySections.text:
## Understand what a change will affect before you approve it

A password change can leave a recovery address or shared session unchanged. Removing an account can interrupt services you still use.

We trace the relevant identities, permissions and recovery routes, explain what they allow, and agree the sequence with you. You gain a clearer basis for changing access without having to work out those dependencies alone. Work beyond the agreed scope or price requires fresh agreement.

commercialOperationalBoundarySections.heading: ## Personal work, with clear authority
commercialOperationalBoundarySections.text:
## Personal work, with clear authority

Shared business accounts are reviewed only where lawful access and agreed authority permit. A dispute does not itself authorize changes to company systems or another person's accounts.

Toza is not a corporate security audit, security-operations service or counter-espionage engagement. We do not investigate the other side, reconstruct events forensically, collect legal evidence or give legal opinions. We do not promise to find or close every possible access path.

You remain present, approve material changes and control your credentials. Toza does not keep them for ongoing use, remotely control your devices, monitor them or install security software on them.

Your attorney or adviser can be involved with your permission. An authorized summary explains the work; it is not a forensic report or evidence document. [Privacy and service boundaries](/en/faq.html) · [Information for attorneys](/en/attorneys.html)

commercialOperationalBoundarySections.heading: ## Access shared in good faith can still matter
commercialOperationalBoundarySections.text:
## Access shared in good faith can still matter

Help with an account or a shared family service can connect several parts of your digital life. The effects may extend beyond the arrangement you remember making.

Dr. Tabansky examines the relevant connections within your authorized environment and agreed scope, including access to private data and the arrangements you depend on to manage your accounts. You gain an explanation of what remains connected and what separating it would mean.

Remaining access does not establish that a relative has used it or acted improperly.

commercialOperationalBoundarySections.heading: ## Work through your own access with expert help
commercialOperationalBoundarySections.text:
## Work through your own access with expert help

**Private Exposure Assessment · Typically four hours**

**₪3,600 including VAT**

The paid visit includes inspection of relevant access on one main phone and one PC, iPad or second phone, including digital identities, accounts, apps, recovery routes and access to data. We complete the agreed intake, access mapping, diagnosis and approved urgent first aid where safely possible within scope.

You receive a practical summary of what was reviewed, found and changed, what remains and the next steps, even if you buy nothing further. We review only what is disclosed, observable or otherwise lawfully accessible within your authorized environment and agreed scope. Additional work or price requires your agreement first.

[What the initial visit includes](/en/private-exposure-assessment.html)

commercialOperationalBoundarySections.heading: ## Make deliberate choices about future access
commercialOperationalBoundarySections.text:
## Make deliberate choices about future access

Personal Shield hardens the agreed settings and access arrangements to reflect your current circumstances. It includes personal teaching and verification. You learn practical habits for granting access, sharing information and recovering accounts in the resulting setup. The scope and price are agreed separately; additional people or a different environment require their own agreed scope.

[Full services, prices and credit conditions](/en/pricing.html) · [How Toza helps](/en/what-happens-during-the-visit.html)

commercialOperationalBoundarySections.heading: ## Your information and your attorney
commercialOperationalBoundarySections.text:
## Your information and your attorney

You remain present, approve material changes and control your credentials. Toza does not keep them for ongoing use, remotely control your devices, monitor them or install security software on them.

A family connection does not authorize work on someone else's account or device. Toza does not determine who is entitled to an account, document or asset. We do not investigate relatives, reconstruct past events forensically, collect evidence or give legal advice.

With your authorization, an attorney-friendly summary can describe the work and remaining issues. A referral does not automatically give counsel access to findings or personal information. The summary is not a forensic report or evidence document, and the work does not guarantee that every exposure is found or removed.

[Privacy and service boundaries](/en/faq.html) · [Information for attorneys](/en/attorneys.html)

commercialOperationalBoundarySections.heading: ## When a referral may help
commercialOperationalBoundarySections.text:
## When a referral may help

- Someone appears to know private information the client did not knowingly share.
- The client is unsure which devices, recovery routes or shared services still connect them to a former partner, colleague or relative.
- Password changes have not clarified who can regain access or see shared information.
- Personal accounts or devices overlap with a business or family dispute.
- The client needs to understand the consequences of changes before authorizing them.

These concerns can justify a review. They do not establish unauthorized access or wrongdoing.

commercialOperationalBoundarySections.heading: ## Work starts with the client's authority
commercialOperationalBoundarySections.text:
## Work starts with the client's authority

A referral does not authorize access to devices, accounts or findings. The client must authorize the work and have lawful authority over the environment being reviewed. They remain present, control their credentials and approve material changes.

Toza does not keep credentials for ongoing use, remotely control or monitor devices, or install security software on them. Coordination with counsel requires the client's permission; the referring attorney is not automatically a recipient of personal information or findings.

commercialOperationalBoundarySections.heading: ## Hands-on inspection, diagnosis and urgent first aid
commercialOperationalBoundarySections.text:
## Hands-on inspection, diagnosis and urgent first aid

**Private Exposure Assessment · Typically four hours**

**₪3,600 including VAT**

Dr. Tabansky inspects the relevant access with the client on one main phone and one PC, iPad or second phone, including digital identities, accounts, apps, recovery routes and access to data. We complete the agreed intake, access mapping, diagnosis and approved urgent first aid where safely possible within scope.

The client receives a practical summary of what was reviewed, found and changed, what remains and the next steps, even if they buy nothing further. Review is limited to what is disclosed, observable or otherwise lawfully accessible within the authorized environment and agreed scope. Additional work or price requires agreement first.

[What the initial visit includes](/en/private-exposure-assessment.html)

commercialOperationalBoundarySections.heading: ## Coordinate consequential changes
commercialOperationalBoundarySections.text:
## Coordinate consequential changes

Changing recovery details, ending shared access or separating services can interrupt access or create notifications. Toza explains the relevant effects before material changes are approved. With the client's permission, timing can be coordinated with counsel. Legal strategy remains with the attorney; the client authorizes technical changes.

commercialOperationalBoundarySections.heading: ## A practical summary, with clear limits
commercialOperationalBoundarySections.text:
## A practical summary, with clear limits

With the client's explicit authorization, an attorney-friendly summary can describe the work and remaining issues. The client decides what may be disclosed. A summary or dated record does not establish what another person did.

Toza does not investigate other people, reconstruct events forensically, preserve a chain of custody, prepare court evidence or provide legal conclusions. The work and its records are not a forensic report or evidence document and do not guarantee that every exposure is found or removed.

[Privacy and service boundaries](/en/faq.html)
